scenarios.name: Stage an import of freshly exported customization settings

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon customization dialog is open in the MCAD Software
the Part 3D Model custom panel list is empty with no pending changes
the user has exported the current customization settings to a new XML file
the user selects that exported XML file and clicks "Open"
the ribbon customization dialog remains open
the Part 3D Model target indicates a pending change
the Part 3D Model custom panel list remains empty
no custom panel appears on the active ribbon
